SELECT C.COMMENT_NO, C.COMMENT_CONTENT, C.USER_NO, C.COMMUNITY_NO, C.CREATED_AT, C.PARENT_COMMENT_NO, C.COMMENT_DEPTH, C.DELETE_YN, U.USER_NICKNAME, U.USER_TYPE FROM COMMENT_TBL C JOIN USER_TBL U ON C.USER_NO = U.USER_NO WHERE C.COMMUNITY_NO = #{communityNo}
START WITH C.PARENT_COMMENT_NO = 0 CONNECT BY PRIOR C.COMMENT_NO = C.PARENT_COMMENT_NO ORDER SIBLINGS BY C.CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMMENT_TBL ( COMMENT_NO, COMMENT_CONTENT, USER_NO, COMMUNITY_NO, CREATED_AT, PARENT_COMMENT_NO, COMMENT_DEPTH, DELETE_YN ) VALUES ( SEQ_COMMENT_NO.NEXTVAL, #{commentContent}, #{userNo}, #{communityNo}, SYSDATE, #{parentCommentNo}, #{commentDepth}, DEFAULT )
